title: Actual cyclic norm branches and the odd-prime coefficient map
proved_results: Explicit mutually inverse full maps L=F semidirect_omega C3 <-> C3 amalg C3 with the original F identified as the kernel.
The original full defect is exactly D(k)^(-1)=(h y^(-k) eta)^3.
The two specified compact norm branches R0,R1, with unique original F-conjugators, map homeomorphically onto T by (k,w)->2k+1; the original boundary-conjugator fiber is retained.
The actual normalized original z-reflection is r=Omega^2(s); both transporter substitutions pass through the named quotient maps without a quotient-centralizer uniqueness assertion.
For every odd p the original maximal pro-p quotient has a fixed subgroup with a split surjective commutator-coefficient homomorphism to Z_p, constructed using the explicit midpoint map.
The map from the full fixed subgroup C_F(alpha)={1} to that pro-p fixed subgroup has zero image under the coefficient map.
An explicit continuous family H_r through the actual h_p solves the original local coboundary and first symmetry and realizes every central coefficient r in Z_p.
At p=5 with the original standard involution, the constructed local H_1 has no unit zero of its cyclic norm word, while the original full h=1 maps to H_0=1.
